decision.comment: Data audit stage is clean and internally consistent. All 11 integrity checks pass (official_split, train/val indices, labels, pixels, shape, disjointness). PathMNIST 9-class 28×28 RGB with train=89996/val=10004/test=7180 matches the official MedMNIST distribution exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5 cross-checks against verified_archive_md5; SHA-256 present. Zero duplicates, zero blank images, zero train–val overlap. Class counts sum correctly to split sizes; imbalance ratio ≈1.63 is modest. Channel statistics (means 0.53–0.74, stds 0.12–0.18) are consistent with [0,1] RGB and justify the z-score normalization choice in the representation plan. The three augmentations selected (hflip, brightness, rotate90) are all built-in primitives and do not require extension approval per pipeline rules; the pending_review entry for tissue_geometric_aug in the extension gate is redundant but harmless and does not invalidate the augmentation plan. The compact_conv_stem_transformer proposal is a model-architecture item, not an augmentation, and its pending status is appropriate. Minor non-blocking notes: (1) llm_model_digest is null for ollama qwen3.8, slightly weakening full reproducibility of LLM-assisted analysis; (2) test split was not individually profiled (test_imbalance_ratio=1.0, test_to_train_prevalence_ratio empty), which is informational since the test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K); (3) prior-art grounding relies on curated cache excerpts rather than live retrieval, flagged as a deterministic warning in the prior_art stage but not a data-integrity concern. No deterministic findings are present. The data_audit stage is ready to proceed.

Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
